results.name: P2-1 [V-D1] a late same-post update with unchanged data (the open-time enrichment arriving after the failure) keeps the failure text and native link; the failed media element is unchanged
P2-2 [V-D1] superseded same-post work: open A, move to B, back to A, A fails; two late deliveries of the same cached post for A keep the failure state and link
P2-3 [V-D1 + V-D8] after the late same-post update the native link is still usable: hit test at its centre = the link; a click there targets it, is not prevented and does not close the viewer
P2-4 [current work] a same-post update that starts a new load (new URL) is still applied after a failure: the failure state is cleared and the new source is loaded
P2-5 [current work] a metadata-pending target is upgraded by its enrichment (sample -> original, in place) and the pending loading state is replaced
P2-6 [preserved] a late update for a different post is ignored (post-ID guard): target and media unchanged
P2-7 [preserved] image -> video type change from metadata rebuilds the element (replaceMedia path)
P2-8 [preserved] same-element video URL upgrade: src swapped, load() and an autoplay play() (playback behavior unchanged)
P2-9 [preserved] a click on the empty stage still closes the viewer, and close releases the video (pause, src removed)
P2-10 [preserved] unmodified viewer keys: ArrowRight / ArrowLeft navigate, Escape closes
P2-11 [preserved] native-navigation fallback on a fresh failure (no late update): failure text and native link to the card post, link pointer-interactive (V-D8)
